verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is Bitbucket's own claim that you can "build custom integrations to meet the exact needs of your organization," which implies programmatic access but never names or documents a public API. The OpenAPI probes returned 404, but only on support.atlassian.com paths, so they neither confirm nor contradict an API. The MCP-server probe belongs to a separate story and is not credited here. missing for 10: explicit documentation of a public REST API (endpoints, authentication, reference), a discoverable OpenAPI spec, any coverage of what operations can be driven programmatically, and hands-on or independent corroboration.
